task.title: Install and register the RHEL server
task.shortdesc: To prepare Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) for a proof of concept Red Hat Quay deployment, you can install RHEL 9, register the system, and attach a subscription. You can then update to the latest packages before deploying components.

step.cmd: Install the latest RHEL 9 server. You can do a minimal, shell-access only install, or Server plus GUI if you want a desktop.
Register and subscribe your RHEL server system as described in How to register and subscribe a RHEL system to the Red Hat Customer Portal using Red Hat Subscription-Manager
Enter the following commands to register your system and list available subscriptions. Choose an available RHEL server subscription, attach to its pool ID, and upgrade to the latest software:

info.codeblock: # subscription-manager register --username=<user_name> --password=<password> # subscription-manager refresh # subscription-manager list --available # subscription-manager attach --pool=<pool_id> # yum update -y
